name: 93446 · Paso Robles, CA
findings: ZIP 93446 (Paso Robles) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93446 (Paso Robles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93446 (Paso Robles) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events

observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
